t: Proof and Author Copies
s: Proof copies feature a “Not for Resale” watermark and unique barcode with no ISBN. Proofs are intended as a test copy for you to review prior to submitting for publication. Author copies are prints of your live book offered to you at print cost. Author copies don’t include unpublished (draft) changes you’ve made on KDP.

t: Start a Book Series
s: KDP allows you to create a book series and sell it on Amazon. You can start a series with any book format (i.e. eBook, paperback, or hardcover). And you don’t need to have all books in your series complete before creating one. Books can be added or removed from a series at any time.
